name: Nitrogen Fixation (V-dependent)
notes: DEPRECATED: Old single-pathway schema. Will be converted to multi-pathway network. Vanadium-dependent nitrogen fixation via alternative nitrogenase enzyme complex. Less common than Mo-nitrogenase, found when molybdenum is scarce. Reduces N2 to NH3 using vnfHDGK complex with a vanadium-iron cofactor (FeV-co). Similar structure to Mo-nitrogenase but with vanadium instead of molybdenum.

nodes.name: nitrogenase complex (V-dependent)
nodes.notes: Complete V-nitrogenase complex: vnfD (VFe alpha) + vnfK (VFe beta) + vnfG (VFe delta) + vnfH (Fe protein). All four subunits required. KEGG: K22896+K22897+K22898+K22899

scoring.notes: All genes (vnfH, vnfD, vnfK, vnfG) required for functional V-nitrogenase. All are markers for V-dependent system.
